address: 396 rue Notre-Dame Ouest, Montréal, H2Y 1T9, Canada
bio: With its decor of marble and mirrors, this chic and elegant new establishment creates the ideal atmosphere for a business lunch as well as dinner for two. The delightfully simple menu harmoniously unites French and Italian influences. You'll find dishes such as steak frites, Arctic char with beurre blanc, focaccia with red pepper, and cavatelli with deliciously spicy 'nduja. For dinner, consider sharing a duck crown or côte de bœuf. At lunchtime, the set menu is an excellent value for the money....
